purpose: Inputs the end-to-end suite drives. Copies, not moves: examples/ remains the application's own example corpus, and src/parseTTL.roundtrip.test.js still reads examples/full-test-import-export.ttl. Pinning copies here means editing an example cannot silently change what an end-to-end test asserts, and tightening an assertion here cannot disturb the examples users are shown. Convention borrowed from linked-data-explorer's e2e-fixtures/, including this manifest and its source field.

fixtures.role: The service imported at step 1, and the baseline every later assertion measures against. Deliberately comprehensive: service, organization, legal resource, cost, output, 5 temporal rules, 5 parameters, 6 CPRMV rules, 8 concepts, an embedded DMN with full validation metadata, and a vendor section — so that a field silently lost on import or re-export has somewhere to show up.
fixtures.source: examples/full-test-import-export.ttl, copied 2026-09-06 after two changes made in that original. Steven selected both RONL Concepts in the Legal tab and re-exported, adding cprmv:hasAnalysis (WetsanalyseJAS) and cprmv:hasMethod (iKnow) and upgrading the file from the CPRMV 0.3.0 namespace to 0.4.1. It was then regenerated through the current ttlGenerator with a vendorService added, because the file carried no vendor triples at all despite being named full-test — the ronl:VendorService model spans nine source files and is published RDF, so a comprehensive fixture that omits it is not comprehensive. Regenerating also picked up the dmn-variables skos:ConceptScheme block the current generator emits and the older file lacked.

fixtures.role: The replacement decision model attached at step 4, deployed at step 5 and evaluated at step 6. Chosen because its six boolean/double eligibility inputs and its zorgtoeslag + annotation outputs make an exact-value assertion possible: the request body in the spec yields 1150 and a specific annotation string, so a decision table that stopped matching would fail rather than answer 200 with an empty result set.

The default model for the authoring journey. Pinned here so the default cannot drift when the examples corpus changes; E2E_DMN still resolves names against examples/organizations, so any of the 31 models there can be driven on demand.
